description: Export a BigQuery table or query result to GCS as parquet / CSV / JSONL / AVRO. The classic warehouse → lake step at the end of an ELT pipeline. Two source modes: source_table_id (uses BQ EXTRACT job — faster for whole tables) or source_query (uses EXPORT DATA SQL — flexible).

outputs.description: One row per resulting GCS object (uri, size_bytes, content_type, updated).

project_id.description: Billing project. Defaults to the SA's project.
project_id.label: Project ID

source_table_id.description: Fully-qualified BQ table id to extract. Mutually exclusive with source_query.
source_table_id.label: Source Table ID

source_query.description: SELECT to export via EXPORT DATA. Supports {placeholder} substitution.
source_query.label: Source Query

destination_uri.label: Destination URI
destination_uri.description: GCS URI; use a `*` wildcard for sharded exports.

format.label: Format
format.description: One of: parquet / csv / json / avro.

compression.description: Compression codec. parquet supports snappy/gzip/zstd; csv+jsonl support gzip; avro supports deflate/snappy.
compression.label: Compression

overwrite.description: Allow overwriting existing GCS objects at the destination URI.
overwrite.label: Overwrite

deps.description: Lineage-only upstream asset keys (no data passed at runtime).
deps.label: Deps

name: BigQuery to GCS Export
